# Executive AI Institute

> People-first AI strategy for senior leaders: leadership psychology alongside hands-on technical mastery.

Founded by Jonscott Turco and Jamie Bykov-Brett. Canonical host is www.executiveaiinstitute.com.

## Start here
- [Home](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/)
- [About](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/about/)
- [Programs](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/programs/): from a one-hour primer to ongoing work.
- [Coaching](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/coaching/)

## Writing and research
- [Insights](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/insights/): essays on AI leadership and organisational change. Around 100 articles; the sitemap lists them all.
- [Reports](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/reports/): enterprise AI briefings.
- [AI leadership roadmap](https://www.executiveaiinstitute.com/roadmap/): a free 12-question diagnostic.
